Test that calling play() and pause() triggers async play, timeupdate and pause events.

RUN(video.play())
RUN(video.pause())
SCRIPT DONE
EVENT(play) TEST(video.paused) OK
EVENT(timeupdate) TEST(video.paused) OK
EVENT(pause) TEST(video.paused) OK
END OF TEST
